in_marathi.name: Sunilkumar
in_marathi.long_meaning: Sunilkumar हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Sunilkumar is derived from the Sanskrit words 'Surya' and 'Kumar', which mean 'Sun' and 'Prince' respectively. This name is given to a boy born on a day when the Sun is in a prominent position, symbolizing his royal and powerful nature.
